info.submission: Fixed boxplot TypeError by filtering dataframe to only numeric columns. The error occurred because the code tried to create boxplots for all columns including non-numeric ones. Changed `for col, value in df.items():` to `for col, value in df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).items():` to ensure only numeric columns are plotted.
